title: Rift Blade
text: Place a Space Microcore in the first slot of either crystal workstation; the second slot remains empty and displays a reserved ghost.

One piercing blade travels 128 blocks toward the crosshair without gravity. Contact applies written effects to entities and spells without consuming the blade; each blade resolves each target only once.

The cut happens first: 20% of current health, or 5% for bosses. Infusion raises these to 50% and 10%, rounded upward with a minimum of 2 health. Hurt immunity is temporarily cleared to apply the written effects afterward. Players can also be hurt.
